The Item Identification * plugin keeps its table private, so the herb and seed rows are reproduced here; every other * category in that plugin (logs, ores, potions and so on) is deliberately left out. * *

Look items up by their canonical (un-noted) id, as Item Identification does. */ enum ItemTag { //Seeds GUAM_SEED(Kind.SEED, "Guam", "G", ItemID.GUAM_SEED), MARRENTILL_SEED(Kind.SEED, "Marren", "M", ItemID.MARRENTILL_SEED), TARROMIN_SEED(Kind.SEED, "Tarro", "TAR", ItemID.TARROMIN_SEED), HARRALANDER_SEED(Kind.SEED, "Harra", "HAR", ItemID.HARRALANDER_SEED), RANARR_SEED(Kind.SEED, "Ranarr", "R", HUASCA_SEED(Kind.SEED, "Huasca", "HUA", ItemID.HUASCA_SEED), REDBERRY_SEED(Kind.SEED, "Redberry", "RED", ItemID.REDBERRY_BUSH_SEED), CADAVABERRY_SEED(Kind.SEED, "Cadava", "CAD", ItemID.CADAVABERRY_BUSH_SEED), DWELLBERRY_SEED(Kind.SEED, "Dwell", "DWEL", ItemID.DWELLBERRY_BUSH_SEED), JANGERBERRY_SEED(Kind.SEED, "Janger", "JANG", ItemID.JANGERBERRY_BUSH_SEED), WHITEBERRY_SEED(Kind.SEED, "White", "WHIT", ItemID.WHITEBERRY_BUSH_SEED), POISON_IVY_SEED(Kind.SEED, "Ivy", "POI", ItemID.POISONIVY_BUSH_SEED), GRAPE_SEED(Kind.SEED, "Grape", "GRA", ItemID.GUAM_LEAF, ItemID.UNIDENTIFIED_GUAM), MARRENTILL(Kind.HERB, "Marren", "M", ItemID.MARENTILL, ItemID.UNIDENTIFIED_MARENTILL), TARROMIN(Kind.HERB, "Tarro", "TAR", ItemID.TARROMIN, ItemID.UNIDENTIFIED_TARROMIN), HARRALANDER(Kind.HERB, "Harra", "HAR", ItemID.HARRALANDER, ItemID.UNIDENTIFIED_HARRALANDER), RANARR(Kind.HERB, "Ranarr", "R", ItemID.RANARR_WEED, ItemID.UNIDENTIFIED_RANARR), TOADFLAX(Kind.HERB, "Toad", "TOA", ItemID.TOADFLAX, ItemID.UNIDENTIFIED_TOADFLAX), IRIT(Kind.HERB, "Irit", "I", ItemID.IRIT_LEAF, ItemID.UNIDENTIFIED_IRIT), AVANTOE(Kind.HERB, "Avan", "A", ItemID.AVANTOE, ItemID.UNIDENTIFIED_AVANTOE), KWUARM(Kind.HERB, "Kwuarm", "K", ItemID.KWUARM, ItemID.UNIDENTIFIED_KWUARM), SNAPDRAGON(Kind.HERB, "Snap", "S", ItemID.SNAPDRAGON, ItemID.UNIDENTIFIED_SNAPDRAGON), CADANTINE(Kind.HERB, "Cadan", "C", ItemID.CADANTINE, ItemID.UNIDENTIFIED_CADANTINE), LANTADYME(Kind.HERB, "Lanta", "L", ItemID.LANTADYME, ItemID.UNIDENTIFIED_LANTADYME), DWARF_WEED(Kind.HERB, "Dwarf", "D", ItemID.DWARF_WEED, ItemID.UNIDENTIFIED_DWARF_WEED), TORSTOL(Kind.HERB, "Torstol", "TOR", ItemID.TORSTOL, ItemID.UNIDENTIFIED_TORSTOL), HUASCA(Kind.HERB, "Huasca", "HUA", ItemID.HUASCA, ItemID.UNIDENTIFIED_HUASCA), ARDRIGAL(Kind.HERB, "Ardrig", "ARD", ItemID.ARDRIGAL, ItemID.UNIDENTIFIED_ARDRIGAL), ROGUES_PURSE(Kind.HERB, "Rogue", "ROG", ItemID.ROGUES_PURSE, ItemID.UNIDENTIFIED_ROGUES_PURSE), SITO_FOIL(Kind.HERB, "Sito", "SF", ItemID.SITO_FOIL, ItemID.UNIDENTIFIED_SITO_FOIL), SNAKE_WEED(Kind.HERB, "Snake", "SW", ItemID.SNAKE_WEED, ItemID.UNIDENTIFIED_SNAKE_WEED), VOLENCIA_MOSS(Kind.HERB, "Volenc", "V", ItemID.VOLENCIA_MOSS, ItemID.UNIDENTIFIED_VOLENCIA_MOSS); enum Kind { SEED, HERB } private final Kind kind; private final String mediumName; private final String shortName; private final int[] itemIds; ItemTag(Kind kind, String mediumName, String shortName, int... itemIds) { this.kind = kind; this.mediumName = mediumName; this.shortName = shortName; this.itemIds = itemIds; } private static final Map BY_ITEM_ID = new HashMap<>(); static { for (ItemTag tag : values()) { for (int id : tag.itemIds) { BY_ITEM_ID.put(id, tag); } } } /** @return the tag for a canonical item id, or {@code null} if it is not a herb or seed */ static ItemTag get(int canonicalItemId) { return BY_ITEM_ID.get(canonicalItemId); } boolean isSeed() { return kind == Kind.SEED; } String getShortName() { return shortName; } String getMediumName() { return mediumName; } int[] getItemIds() { return itemIds.clone(); } }
